title: Fishing depth: bait, biome crates, lava fishing, weather and time effects
player_outcome: Fishing like Terraria: bait items (worms, fireflies, butterflies, master bait…) with bait power that consumes, biome crates (jungle, sky, corruption, crimson, hallowed, dungeon, frozen, oasis, ocean, obsidian/lava), lava fishing with the right gear, and rain/time/moon affecting catches; quest fish per biome for the Angler.
design: Core fishing power formula (rod + bait + accessories + weather/time/moon), bait consumption, biome crate loot tables, lava fishing gate (hotline/lavaproof), quest fish entries; critters caught with bug nets become bait.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: liquids.cmds or a fishing smoke block catches with bait
